function.name: add_ai_task_job
function.description: Create a new AI task job for the current site.

active.description: Whether the job is active. Default is true

frequence.description: Repeat frequency as a JSON integer: 0=Day, 1=Hour, 3=Minutes, 4=Week, 5=Month, 6=Second. Do not send a name or 2.

frequenceUnit.description: Positive integer number of frequency units between runs when repeat=true; for example frequence=1 and frequenceUnit=2 means every two hours.

prompt.description: Prompt executed by the scheduled AI task
